note: domain_menus_superfish is a glue submodule providing one block plugin, domain_menus_active_domain_superfish_block (DomainMenusSuperfishBlock, extends superfish's SuperfishBlock, category 'Superfish'). It adds a single 'menu_name' setting whose options come from domain_menus.settings:domain_menus_menu_names; getDerivativeId() resolves it to dm<activeDomainId>-<name> at render. No config object, permissions, Drush, or configure route. Block config entities can be created/read without any Domain records (rendering needs a domain, but placement/config does not). Medium reads back a placed block's menu_name; hard places a block using this plugin, verified by scanning block config entities for the plugin id. Fixture block ids are namespaced dmsuperfish_*.

evals.prompt: The domain_menus_superfish module adds a block for showing a domain's menu with Superfish. What is the block's plugin id and which block class does it extend?
evals.expected_output: The block plugin id is domain_menus_active_domain_superfish_block (class DomainMenusSuperfishBlock), which extends superfish's SuperfishBlock and appears under the 'Superfish' block category.

evals.prompt: When placing the domain_menus_superfish block, what extra setting does it add beyond the normal Superfish options, and where do that setting's options come from?
evals.expected_output: It adds a required 'menu_name' select; its options are the domain-menu names from domain_menus.settings:domain_menus_menu_names. At render, getDerivativeId() turns the chosen name into the active domain's menu id dm<activeDomainId>-<name>.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a placed block that uses the domain_menus_superfish Superfish domain-menu block. Inspect the block configuration and tell me which domain menu name (menu_name setting) it is configured to show.
evals.expected_output: The block's menu_name setting is 'footer' (block config entity with plugin domain_menus_active_domain_superfish_block; read settings.menu_name).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place the domain_menus_superfish 'Domain menus active domain menu' (Superfish) block so it shows the domain menu named 'main'. Apply the placement to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity exists whose plugin is domain_menus_active_domain_superfish_block with settings.menu_name = 'main' (e.g. Block::create(['id'=>'...','theme'=>default,'region'=>'content','plugin'=>'domain_menus_active_domain_superfish_block','settings'=>['id'=>'domain_menus_active_domain_superfish_block','label'=>'...','menu_name'=>'main']])->save()).
